premises.text: Many aspiring music artists lack access to quality producers or cannot afford to pursue a career in music

premises.text: Rekrogram provides an all-in-one mobile production marketplace for creating original songs
premises.evidence_span: Rekrogram is an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, a recording studio, and a social network that allows our users to create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5

premises.text: Users can discover beats, write songs, record, and share videos through Rekrogram
premises.evidence_span: Our users can discover beats, they can write songs to those beats, they can record songs to those beats, and they can also shoot a video to that song that they just created

premises.text: Rekrogram connects producers with aspiring artists, providing a user-friendly and affordable solution
premises.evidence_span: We're the user-friendly, convenient, and affordable solution that connects producer Tony with aspiring artist Willie

premises.text: Rekrogram allows producers to monetize their beats and provides access to affordable production for artists
premises.evidence_span: The bottom line is we make money for producers like Tony, and we provide access and save money for guys like Willie

premises.text: Rekrogram is an original content platform that does not rely on major label licensing
premises.evidence_span: we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

value.text: Aspiring music artists gain access to affordable music production and collaboration opportunities
value.evidence_span: the ability to awaken their inner musician
